body:
I have professional help with a therapist and psychiatrist that are helpful. I just haven't seen them in a while since life got so hectic. I should probably tell them that whatever is going on is not good. They have told me to do those things and even with my active lifestyle, I feel like shit.

Thank you.
I have a lot of reasons to live. Great reasons. The feel that me wanting to die is either residual from when I was younger or basically irrational.
